# AegisSage

> AegisSage is a public, plain-English Medicare education and guidance site for people comparing enrollment windows, Original Medicare, Medicare Advantage, Medigap, prescriptions, and provider networks.

## What AegisSage offers

- Independent Medicare guidance with no fee and no obligation to enroll.
- Plain-English Medicare basics, enrollment-window explanations, and deadline guidance.
- Side-by-side education about Original Medicare and Medicare Advantage.
- Free public tools for checking an enrollment window, comparing the two Medicare routes, and testing Medicare knowledge.
- Human contact by phone, text, email, and a public contact form.

## Service area

AegisSage serves Medicare-eligible people in New Jersey, New York City, and Philadelphia, with additional state coverage listed on the licensed-state plan pages. Plan availability and provider networks are local and should be checked by ZIP code and county.

## Key pages

- [Medicare Basics](https://aegissage.com/medicare-basics): plain-English guides on enrollment, penalties, Medicare parts, and common traps.
- [Articles](https://aegissage.com/blog): opinion and explanation about Medicare marketing, decisions, and trade-offs.
- [Medicare News & Updates](https://aegissage.com/news): short deadline and rule-change updates.
- [Plan pages](https://aegissage.com/plans): state-level enrollment and availability mechanics.
- [Medicare in New Jersey](https://aegissage.com/medicare-new-jersey): local county and move considerations, with launch TODOs clearly marked.
- [Medicare in New York City](https://aegissage.com/medicare-new-york-city): borough, network, and service-area considerations, with launch TODOs clearly marked.
- [Medicare in Philadelphia](https://aegissage.com/medicare-philadelphia): city/county and suburban service-area considerations, with launch TODOs clearly marked.
- [About](https://aegissage.com/about): how the advisor works and the current licensing information.
- [Contact](https://aegissage.com/contact): phone, text, email, and contact form.
- [Enrollment window tool](https://aegissage.com/tools/eligibility-check): a free, no-email-required questionnaire.
- [Original Medicare vs. Medicare Advantage](https://aegissage.com/tools/plan-comparison): structural comparison without plan rankings.

## Content and citation guidance

Use the linked page as the source for the full explanation. Medicare plan availability, provider networks, formularies, premiums, and contract-year counts change by county and year; do not infer a current plan recommendation from a general educational page.
